title: Automated 96-well format high throughput colony formation assay for siRNA library screen
protocol: Dilute the siRNA library in siRNA buffer to a final concentration of 0.4 μM.
Mix well, by pipetting up and down multiple times.
Store diluted siRNA library plates at −80°C for long-term storage.
Thaw HeLa cells five days before transfection.
Plate thawed HeLa cells (2 million) in a 175 cm² TC-treated flask with 30 ml high glucose DMEM and 10% FBS.
Incubate the flask at 37°C with 5% CO₂ for two days without medium change.
Passage the cells three days before transfection, plating one-quarter into each of four new 175 cm² TC-treated flasks.
Incubate the flasks at 37°C in 5% CO₂ for three days without medium change.
Label fourteen 96-Well V-bottom plates as siRNA PLATE 1–12, MOCK TRANSFECTED, and CONTROL PLATE.
Label thirteen 96-Well Flat-bottom TC-treated plates as CELL ASSAY PLATE 1–12 and MOCK TRANSFECTED.
Label a 96-well deep-well block as the TRANSFECTION REAGENT PLATE.
Dilute control siRNAs in 1× siRNA buffer using RNase-free 1.5 mL tubes.
Add 150 μL of each diluted siRNA to the first and last column of a V-bottom 96-well CONTROL PLATE according to the plate map.
Keep solutions at room temperature (18°C–22°C) for the shortest time possible.
Add 420 μL of Dharmafect1 to 41.58 mL of serum-free medium in a 50 mL tube.
Mix well.
Dispense 430 μL/well into all wells of a deep well 96-well TRANSFECTION REAGENT PLATE.
Transfer 10 μL of 0.4 μM siRNA from each library plate to one 96-Well V-bottom plate labeled as siRNA PLATE 1–12 using the Janus 96-Tip MDT with P50 tips.
Transfer 10 μL of dilution buffer into each well of the MOCK TRANSFECTED plate.
Transfer 10 μL of control siRNA from the CONTROL PLATE to the siRNA PLATES 1–12 and the MOCK TRANSFECTED plate using the Janus 96-Tip MDT with P50 tips.
Transfer 30 μL of diluted Dharmafect1 from the deep well 96-well TRANSFECTION REAGENT PLATE to the MOCK TRANSFECTION plate.
Mix three times using a 15 μL volume.
Repeat with the 12 siRNA COMPLEX FORMATION plates, using a fresh box of tips for each.
Allow the complexes to form for 20 min at room temperature.
Prepare the 13 flat-bottom TC-treated CELL ASSAY PLATES by adding 25 μL of DMEM + 10% FBS (without P/S) to all wells using the PE FlexDrop reagent dispenser.
Trypsinize HeLa cells from four 175 cm² flasks.
Resuspend and count the trypsinized cells in Trypan blue.
Dilute live cells to 80,000 cells/mL in at least 150 mL of DMEM + 10% FBS P/S-free media in a 500 mL glass bottle.
Attach the glass bottle containing the diluted HeLa cells to the FlexDrop and prime the dispenser tubing.
Add the siRNA complexes to the 96-well TC-treated plates using the FlexDrop.
Add the cells to the 96-well TC-treated plates using the FlexDrop.
Transfer 20 μL of siRNA complexes to the 12 CELL ASSAY PLATES containing 25 μL medium.
Do not add siRNA to the MOCK TRANSFECTION Plate.
Dispense 50 μL of cell suspension to each cell plate, containing 4,000 cells per well.
Incubate each cell plate at room temperature for 20 min to 1 h before placing it in the 37°C 5% CO2 incubator.
Split each of the transfected cell plates into eight 96-well plates after three days at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Label twelve 96-well deep well plates, one for each plate of transfected cells.
Prepare a total of 2.5 L of cell culture media.
Warm 2,500 mL of media in a water bath set at 37°C.
Warm 200 mL trypsin in the same water bath.
Dispense 176 μL of DMEM + 10% FBS Pen/Strep to forty-eight 96-well TC-treated Assay Plates labeled (-) IR.
Store the plates in a plate stacker or with lids.
Visually inspect Well A1 in all plates for PLK1 knock-down validation.
Aspirate the media from the cell plate containing NT control-transfected cells using an 8-channel aspiration adapter and manual multichannel pipette.
Wash the wells once with 50 μL PBS.
Add 50 μL Trypsin per well to trypsinize the cells.
Return the plate to incubator for 10 minutes, confirming under microscope that all cells have lifted before proceeding.
Add 150 μL of medium to all wells after cells have lifted and mix thoroughly.
Count the cells from several wells to calculate the volume needed for a final cell number of 9,600.
Dispense 1,200 μL minus the calculated volume needed into twelve 96-well deep well plates using FlexDrop.
Use Janus 96-Tip MDT with a fresh box of P235 tips to lift and split cells in one plate of transfected cells.
Aspirate the media from the cell plate at 1 mm above well bottom at 10 μL/s.
Add 50 μL PBS at 1 mm above well bottom at 10 μL/s.
Aspirate the PBS from the cell plate at 1 mm above well bottom at 10 μL/s.
Add 50 μL Trypsin per well and return the plate to incubator for 10 min.
Using the Janus MDT, add 150 μL of medium to each well.
Mix 125 μL three times at 1 mm above well bottom with 100% Liquid Level Tracking at 10 μL/s.

Mix the wells four more times once in each quadrant of the well with four 125 μL mixes at 20 μL/s, aspirating at 4 mm above the well bottom and dispensing at 1 mm above the well bottom with 100% Liquid Level Tracking.
Transfer the appropriate calculated volume for 9,600 cells to the deep well plate containing 1,200 μL of media (minus the volume of cells), for a final concentration of 8,000 cells/mL.
Mix the wells four times with four 200 μL mixes at 20 μL/s, aspirating at 4 mm above well bottom and dispensing at 1 mm above well bottom with 100% Liquid Level Tracking.
Transfer 24 μL (192 cells) from the deep well plate to four 96-well TC-treated Assay Plates labeled 0 Gy or (-) IR.
Add 176 μL medium/well to the plates labeled 0 Gy or (-) IR.
Transfer 200 μL (1,600 cells) from the deep well plate to four 96-well TC-treated Assay Plates labeled 7 Gy or (+) IR.
Incubate each cell plate at room temperature for 1 hour before placing it in the incubator.
Repeat steps from transferring cells for each plate of transfected cells.
Incubate un-irradiated plates (labeled 0 Gy or (-) IR) for the remainder of the experiment.
Incubate (labeled 7 Gy or (+) IR) plates for at least 4 hours at 37°C and 5% CO2 before irradiation.
Irradiate half of the 7 Gy plates with 6 MV photons using a Varian IX linear accelerator at gantry angles 0 and 180 degrees to a total dose of 7 Gy.
Repeat irradiation steps for the remainder of the 7 Gy plates.
Incubate un-irradiated (labeled 0 Gy or (-) IR) plates for an additional 6 days.
Incubate irradiated (labeled 7 Gy or (+) IR) plates for 8 days.
Fix, stain, and count colonies.
Prepare Crystal Violet Solution: Mix 5 mg of crystal violet with a total volume of 500 mL made up of 10% ethanol, 50% methanol, and 40% water.
Remove media from 96-well plates (no wash).
Add 20 μL of Crystal Violet Solution per well and leave at room temperature for 2 min.
Wash off the crystal violet using three cycles of 300 μL of water per well, followed by a final aspiration.
Tap plates upside-down to remove any residual liquid.
Leave the plates to dry.
Count colonies using a GelCount colony counter (Oxford Optronix Ltd, Abingdon, UK) at 1,200 dpi resolution and CHARM settings appropriate for the cell line used.
Image the plates using an IN Cell Analyzer 6000 automated microscope fitted with a Nikon 2× objective.
Use the Red excitation laser at 652 nm with a 400 ms exposure time and the Cy5 emission filter (670–742 nm).
Set Laser-based hardware autofocus with an offset from the well bottom of 620 μm to keep the colonies in focus.
Automatically load plates into the imager using a robotic arm and AmbiStore plate stacker, or equivalent.
Unload plates on completion of imaging.
Analyze images to generate total colony area per well.
Segment colonies using an intensity-based threshold (MIN 490 – MAX 65535 Grey levels).
Segment the well.
Identify colonies inside the well mask.
Remove out-of-well objects such as the well rim and debris.
Remove smaller non-colony cell fragments with an area less than 5,000 μm².
Calculate the total area of remaining colonies in the well.
